name: BlockSurvey
description_en:
BlockSurvey is a privacy-focused survey platform combining questionnaire design, distribution, response analysis and optional AI assistance. Its official description says responses are encrypted on the respondent’s device and that the account holder controls the keys. That is a product claim about the data path, not an independent security audit.

It supports conventional and conversational surveys, logic, multilingual questionnaires and several distribution channels. The selection issue is which collection, branding and AI-analysis functions belong to the chosen plan. Survey-language support does not establish the administration interface’s languages.
description_zh:
BlockSurvey 是注重隐私的问卷平台，组合问卷设计、分发、回答分析与可选 AI 辅助。官方说明回答在受访者设备上加密，账户持有人控制密钥。这是对数据路径的产品主张，不是独立安全审计。

它支持传统及对话式问卷、逻辑、多语言问卷与多种分发渠道。选型时要核对收集、品牌及 AI 分析功能分别属于哪个套餐。问卷语言支持不能证明管理界面的语言。

core_features.explanation_en: Vendor describes device-side end-to-end encryption and holder-controlled keys.
core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商描述设备端端到端加密及持有人控制密钥。

core_features.explanation_en: Includes skip/display logic, with piping and advanced question types depending on plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 提供跳转／显示逻辑，引用和高级题型取决于套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: Creation, follow-ups and analysis are distinct tiered capabilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 创建、追问与分析是不同的分档能力。

steps.en: Begin with the account owner, recovery arrangements and authorized collaborators. Test the intended plan rather than assume trial-enabled features will remain. For regulated work, verify the actual DPA or BAA and data-processing terms; a badge or marketing sentence does not approve a particular use. This is a hosted platform in the reviewed sources; no self-hosted package or source license was established.
steps.zh: 先明确账户持有人、恢复安排与获准协作者。按准备长期使用的套餐测试，不能假定试用功能会保留。受监管任务需核对实际 DPA／BAA 和处理条款；徽章或宣传句不能批准具体用途。所读来源呈现托管平台，未建立自托管包或源代码许可。

items.en: This is a candidate when privacy controls matter alongside survey logic and analysis. A basic form may suffice for a low-sensitivity signup, while a panel provider solves respondent recruitment separately. Key-loss recovery, the exact AI decryption/processing boundary and retry behavior for integrations were not verified. If a response is absent, check eligibility, partial submissions, duplicate prevention and quota state before treating it as respondent refusal.
items.zh: 需要隐私控制及问卷逻辑、分析时可列入候选；低敏感注册可能用基础表单就足够，样本供应商则另解决受访者招募。密钥丢失恢复、AI 解密／处理的具体边界和集成重试未核实。若缺少回答，应先检查资格、部分提交、防重复与额度，再解释为受访者拒答。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The detailed table lists a $0 Free plan with three active surveys, ten questions per survey and ten responses; the quota period for those ten was not made explicit. A separate 14-day trial is offered. Monthly/annual-equivalent prices shown are Standard $49/$39, Premium $99/$79 and Team $149/$119 for three users. Paid response allowances are 6,000, 24,000 and 60,000 per year. Premium adds branding and follow-up questions; Team adds AI data analysis and campaigns. Extra responses, email campaigns, SMS and AI credits have separate purchases.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 详细表格列 0 美元 Free，含三份活动问卷、每份十题及十份回答，但未明确十份回答的额度周期；另有 14 天试用。月付／年付等值分别为 Standard 49／39 美元、Premium 99／79 美元、三人 Team 149／119 美元。付费回答额度分别为每年 6,000、24,000、60,000。Premium 增加品牌及追问，Team 增加 AI 数据分析与活动。额外回答、邮件、短信及 AI 积分另购。

sections.title_en: Collect private feedback with a controlled follow-up path
sections.title_zh: 收集私密反馈并控制后续流程
sections.en: For a proposed employee-feedback study, decide which identifiers must not be collected, build a short questionnaire with relevant skip logic, and test both eligible and skipped routes. Share a link or an approved email campaign, then inspect whether the export and report preserve the promised anonymity. AI summaries can assist theme discovery, but read the underlying answers before making a people decision. Connecting a response to an external spreadsheet or CRM creates another data copy whose access must be managed.
sections.zh: 以员工反馈研究为例，先决定哪些标识不得收集，建立简短问卷和适当跳转，测试应答及跳过路径。通过链接或获准邮件活动分发，再检查导出和报表是否保留承诺的匿名性。AI 摘要可辅助发现主题，但人员决策前应读原始回答。把回答连接到外部表格或 CRM 会生成另一份数据副本，需要另管访问。
